def shebang?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#!')
        end

        def multiline_shebang?(comment)
          shebang?(comment) && leading_shebang_lines.include?(comment.loc.line)
        end

        def leading_shebang_lines
          @leading_shebang_lines ||= begin
            lines = []
            expected_line = 1
            processed_source.comments.each do |comment|
              break unless comment.loc.line == expected_line && shebang?(comment)

              lines << expected_line
              expected_line += 1
            end
            lines
          end
        end
